SELECT 
  fish_date_doy,
  COUNT(*) as trip_count,
  SUM(yt) as total_yt,
  SUM(anglers) as total_anglers,
  ROUND(SUM(yt)::float / SUM(anglers)::float, 2) as yt_per_angler
FROM trips
WHERE cls = 'overnight' AND fish_date_doy >= 170 AND fish_date_doy <= 300
GROUP BY fish_date_doy
ORDER BY fish_date_doy
LIMIT 50;

SELECT 
  fish_date_doy,
  COUNT(*) as trip_count,
  SUM(yt) as total_yt,
  SUM(anglers) as total_anglers,
  ROUND(SUM(yt)::float / SUM(anglers)::float, 2) as yt_per_angler
FROM trips
WHERE cls = 'overnight' AND fish_date_doy >= 280 AND fish_date_doy <= 310
GROUP BY fish_date_doy
ORDER BY fish_date_doy;

SELECT 
  ts_doy,
  ROUND(AVG(wtmp_c), 2) as avg_temp_c,
  ROUND(MIN(wtmp_c), 2) as min_temp_c,
  ROUND(MAX(wtmp_c), 2) as max_temp_c,
  COUNT(*) as obs
FROM pier
WHERE ts_doy >= 175 AND ts_doy <= 185
GROUP BY ts_doy
ORDER BY ts_doy;

SELECT 
  ts_doy,
  ROUND(AVG(wtmp_c), 2) as avg_temp_c,
  COUNT(*) as obs
FROM pier
WHERE ts_doy >= 285 AND ts_doy <= 300
GROUP BY ts_doy
ORDER BY ts_doy;

SELECT DISTINCT
  boat,
  fish_date_doy,
  COUNT(*) as scheduled_trips
FROM schedule
WHERE cls = 'overnight' AND fish_date_doy >= 287 AND fish_date_doy <= 295
GROUP BY boat, fish_date_doy
ORDER BY fish_date_doy, boat
LIMIT 30;

SELECT 
  boat,
  fish_date_doy,
  yt,
  anglers,
  ROUND(yt::float / NULLIF(anglers, 0), 2) as yt_per_angler
FROM trips
WHERE boat IN ('Cortez', 'New Lo-An', 'Dolphin III', 'Ranger 85') 
  AND cls = 'overnight'
  AND fish_date_doy >= 280 AND fish_date_doy <= 300
ORDER BY fish_date_doy DESC, boat;
